content: Always consult your healthcare professional for guidance regarding this product and your specific health needs. It is essential to seek complete and accurate information from your healthcare provider to ensure safe and effective use of this product. Store the patch at room temperature, away from heat sources. Do not open the pouch until you are ready to use the patch. Medications should not be flushed down the toilet or poured into a drain unless explicitly instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last updated in July 2024.
